title: A Super Easy Way To Lower Your Stress
author: Michael Linsin
summary: Linsin introduces nasal breathing—breathing exclusively through the nose except while talking or eating—as a simple, scientifically grounded technique for staying calm throughout the teaching day. He explains that nasal passages naturally slow and deepen breathing, engaging the parasympathetic nervous system, and lists eight specific benefits ranging from lower blood pressure and heart rate to improved energy, respiratory filtration, and more graceful, economical movement. He also connects the practice to classroom management directly, noting that it discourages excessive narrating, reminding, and micromanaging of students, and that a calm teacher visibly transmits calm to the class. He frames it as a single easy change that can deliver noticeable relief within the very first hour of practice.

Explains that narrow nasal passages naturally slow breathing and engage the parasympathetic nervous system.
Lists eight specific physiological and behavioral benefits, from lower blood pressure to more graceful movement.
Connects the practice directly to classroom management, noting it discourages excessive narrating and micromanaging of students.
Claims noticeable relief can occur within the very first hour of practicing the technique.
quotes: It’s used by archers, golfers, surgeons, yoga teachers, and others whose performance is so directly linked to their ability to keep their composure.
The narrow passages of the nose force you to slow down your breathing, filling the lower half of your lungs and stimulating parasympathetic nerves that automatically calm the body.
It very effectively removes excitability from your classroom, which is one of the biggest causes of misbehavior. Students take their cue from you, and if you’re calm, they will be too.
Although it may take a few days to develop the habit of nasal breathing, you’ll find it delivering blessed relief within your first hour of practice.
It will show you just how profoundly a naturally calm demeanor positively influences those around you.
Your students. Your colleagues. Even the loved ones you go home to.
